tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Returns the families of custom software One AM builds, each with a short description and the page that documents it. Call this first: the product ids it returns are the ones the other tools accept.

tools.name: search_features
tools.description: Returns the features One AM publishes for a product family. Use it to answer "can it do X?" instead of guessing.

product.description: The product family whose features you need.

tools.name: search_portfolio
tools.description: Returns real One AM case studies, optionally narrowed to a product family or to an industry. Use it before claiming that One AM has or has not built something.

product.description: Only case studies of this product family.

sector.description: Only case studies in this industry.

tools.name: start_project_estimate
tools.description: Opens the page where the visitor describes their project to One AM's assistant, with their first message already written out. It does not send anything: the visitor reads what you wrote and speaks for themselves. Use it when they have asked to be put in touch.

message.description: The visitor's opening message, in their own words and in their language: what they need and for whom.
